question.problem: Which of the following expressions gives all of the vertical asymptotes of the function $f(x)=\operatorname{tan}⁡(3x)+2?$ Assume that $n$ is an integer.

current_example.problem: What expression gives all of the vertical asymptotes of the function  $f(x)=\tan\left(2x\right)?$
current_example.worked_solution:
The asymptotes of $y=\tan x$ are given by the expression

$$
x = \dfrac{\pi}{2} + n \pi,
$$

where $n$ is an integer.

To find the asymptotes of $\tan\left(2x\right),$ we replace the $x$ on the left-hand side of the above with $2x.$ This gives

$$
2x = \dfrac{\pi}{2} + n\pi.
$$

Solving for $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}2x & =\frac{\pi }{2}+n\pi  \\ x & =\frac{\pi }{4}+\frac{n\pi }{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the expression giving all the vertical asymptotes is $x= \dfrac{\pi}{4} + \dfrac{n\pi}{2},$ where $n$ is an integer.
